body.name: Saturated canonical order-only response-law class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{can}}=\{(k,(\mathcal D_i)_{i=1}^k,\mathfrak F,\mu):k\geq1,\ (\mathcal D_i)_{i=1}^k\text{ satisfies finite discrete support},\ \mathfrak F\text{ is the complete canonical order-only response carrier},\ \mu\text{ is a probability law on }\mathfrak F\}\).
